note: Flux has no portable/*.json layer, and the task JSON's portable block is parsed as an exact-keyed capability envelope (sforge/harness/portable_spec.py::parse_capability_envelope) that rejects extra fields. This file therefore plays the role portable/final-suite-manifest.json plays for the tasks with a portable layer: it is the task's final-suite record. It carries no holdout content - only the digest of the instance beside it - and scripts/validate_layout.py checks the two agree.

frozen_instance.provenance: the draw of final-holdout-v2 by scripts/generate_final_manifest.py with its default seed (sha256('final-holdout-v2|flux_moe_ag_scatter_grouped_gemm_dual_h100_seed_v1')[:8]), frozen in-tree as the default build input

draw_policy.default: frozen-instance-by-default: scripts/build_images.sh reads judge/private/final_cases.json unless FINAL_CASES_PATH names another instance, so every host that builds from this tree scores the same cases
draw_policy.composition: paper experiment points (Comet arXiv:2502.19811 v3, FLUX arXiv:2406.06858 v5, bytedance/flux @ 19831ca2) at the papers' non-gated N = I/TP; real model configurations (Hugging Face config.json) in tensor, expert and hybrid parallel deployments at gated N = 2*I/TP over training/prefill, decode and multi-layer token regimes with synthetic routing; the same deployments of four captured models replaying token windows of their own router decisions on mixed real text (judge/private/routing, pinned by sha256 here and in every case); correctness-only edge cases
draw_policy.privacy: the instance and its routing fixtures live on the Judge-only path judge/private/, are staged mode 0600 into a root-only Judge build context and are never present in the Work image; the public suite (images/work/benchmark/public_cases.json, routing fixtures of other models in images/work/benchmark/routing) shares no (K, N, E_rank, topk) identity, seed or model with it
draw_policy.redraw: scripts/generate_final_manifest.py --redraw [--seed <int>] draws a reproducible new instance from a seeded random.Random; a redraw is a NEW suite identity: frozen_instance must be re-recorded here and no earlier score is comparable to it.
